project_description: Follow-up SDD for issue #369. Extend completed reasoning-output-preservation with optional semantic compression of only canonically compressible plain textual reasoning while keeping original artifacts authoritative and preserving exact/native/signed/opaque continuity unchanged. Reuse generic auxiliary/background execution, generation pinning, routing and billing infrastructure without depending on compaction-continuity feature semantics. V1 requires an explicit independent compressor route; preserves exported BackgroundClient source compatibility by adding non-blocking polling as a separate optional capability; bounds input, raw compressor output before decode, decoded surrogates, per-session optional state and feature-instance aggregate optional state; requires a trusted allow/redact/deny data-egress decision for ordinary reasoning text; keeps role/visibility/lineage/principal scope as control-plane metadata but out of model-visible compressor content; and runs original-first asynchronous shadow mode before explicit destination-representability-gated active replay. This spec does not supersede completed reasoning preservation, OpenAI Responses preservation, Codex native compaction, or compaction continuity specs. Post-PR CodeRabbit hardening validated and corrected five substantive safety/compatibility gaps; maintainer approvals and implementation are complete.
